result.headline: Throttle commanded to 0% at 115.637 s and stayed there; aircraft lost most of its altitude before the end.
result.explanation: The propulsion channel (ch[2], throttle loop) dropped to 1100 us with throttle 0% at 115.637 s and stayed there. Attitude loops kept tracking and no mode event was logged, so who or what commanded it is not in this data.

evidence.quote: CHANGE propulsion.throttle at t=115.637 s: 40 -> 0 % (step -40, 20x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: Throttle command fell to zero with no mode change or event. It held 0 to the end of the window (median 0.0 over 110-132.5 s).

evidence.quote: CHANGE actuator.output[ch[2]] at t=117.002 s: 1420 -> 1100 us (step -320, 20x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: The throttle-loop output went to its minimum (1100 us) and stayed there. It follows throttle, so this matches the command, not an independent motor-output fault.

evidence.quote: ROLE actuator.output[ch[2]] follows propulsion.throttle (correlation 0.981 over the recording): it serves that loop
evidence.shows: ch[2] is the propulsion channel. It froze while ch[1], ch[3], ch[4] and ch[5] kept moving.

evidence.quote: SHIFT vehicle.altitude[relative] changed level for good at t=121.388 s: median 49.535 before, 19.581 after m (15.4x its variation before)
evidence.shows: Altitude fell to 6.587 m by the end of the window after the thrust was lost. This is the consequence of the lost thrust.

evidence.quote: EVENT t=0.629 s controller.event[mavros: Battery] mavros: Battery: WARN: Low voltage
evidence.shows: The only event is a start-up battery warning. Nothing is logged near the throttle cut.

checked.check: Event list for the whole recording
checked.result: One event only, the low-voltage warning at 0.629 s. No mode change or failsafe is recorded near the throttle cut.
Throttle median went from 41 to 0 %. ch[2] went from 1436 to 1100 us. Roll tracking error ratio was 2.2, pitch 1.12, yaw 0.16.

checked.about: Propulsion channel as the first change

data_requests.what: Autopilot flight log with mode, RC input, failsafe flags and battery voltage/current
data_requests.window: Around the throttle cut to the end of this flight
data_requests.why_needed: Separates a commanded throttle cut from a battery or output fault.

unobservable.fact: Motor, ESC and wiring condition on the propulsion channel
unobservable.why_it_matters: A fault between the command and the motor would only show as an output change.
unobservable.how_to_observe: Bench test the ESC and motor with the log's throttle profile; inspect connectors.

hypotheses.claim: A fault between the throttle command and the motor stopped thrust.
hypotheses.because: ch[2] followed the throttle command to 1100 us, so the output tracked the command. This area is not excluded.

hypotheses.claim: Pilot, mode logic or a failsafe set throttle to zero at the cut.
hypotheses.because: The throttle command itself went to 0 with no event logged. Attitude loops kept tracking, which fits a command and not a fault in them.

hypotheses.claim: Low battery or a power-side limit removed thrust.
hypotheses.because: A low-voltage warning exists at start-up only. No voltage signal is recorded to test this at the cut.

hypotheses.claim: A roll, pitch or yaw loop fault caused the loss of control.
hypotheses.because: Tracking held after 115.7 s (pitch ratio 1.12, roll 2.2, yaw 0.16). Pitch and altitude changed after the throttle cut.
